title: Simulation already inside J: comparative statics of m* and high-beta Moran search
world_generator: draw_world in sim1_lib.py: e_base=10^U(-0.3,0.3), gamma=10^U(-0.3,0.3), phi=U(0.35,0.80), I0=10^U(-1.0,-0.3). Fresh seeds, checked non-colliding with S5 1000-1119, convexity_search 0-119, wide 5000-5119, named 20261120/2026112020, T27 official 2026112100-2115, and T27 chain block 20261121500-21999.

predictions.P1: At each locked K in {0,1,2,3}, discrete m*(w) (least argmin at that K) is nondecreasing on the locked W_LADDER, and discrete m*(lambda) is nondecreasing on the locked LAM_LADDER at W_FOR_LAM=1. Analytic: Topkis, increasing differences of -J in (m,w) and in (m, lambda) at fixed K, ruin cap slack (exposure is additive).
predictions.P2: At each locked K, m*(W_LOW)=0, m*(W_HIGH)>=1, and the exact threshold W_th(K)=inf{w: m*_K(w)>=1} lies strictly between W_LOW and W_HIGH. Analytic: first model/rollout must pay (CT4-style fixed cost plus the FOC threshold).
predictions.P3: At each locked K, at P3_W=5, P3_LAM=0, discrete m*(c) is nonincreasing on the locked C_LADDER. Analytic: Topkis in (m, -c).
predictions.P4: At the locked P4 prices (w=20, c=0.05, lambda=0) and beta=40, the pooled Moran occupation satisfies: (i) the mode of the marginal on m equals the unique discrete m* of J; (ii) |mean m - m*| <= 1.5. Numerical, not a theorem about finite-sample Moran. Exact Boltzmann on the same cell is a validity screen, not an official pass bar.

pass_rule: OVERALL PASS iff there are 3 official-valid worlds and every official world passes P1, P2, P3 and P4. If fewer than 3 official-valid worlds, the test is INCONCLUSIVE, not a fail. A world that fails a uniqueness, m*-range, connectivity, exact-Boltzmann, or mixing validity check is not official; it does not count as a prediction fail.
notes: Pilot design work used only seeds 20261122800-20261122819 and box-corner probes. Official candidate seeds were not evaluated before lock. Joint (K*,m*) monotonicity of m in w is a diagnostic only, not a gate: layers and rollouts are substitutes.
